name: launchpad
description: KOZMOS Launchpad: a pane of big launch buttons. It learns your most-used slash commands as you run them, keeps pinned favorites and saved prompts, and runs a command or fills the prompt box in one press. /launchpad toggles it; save <text>, rm <n>, pin <cmd>, unpin <cmd>, list.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Launchpad pane when a session starts.
